lines: Harish Narshi Dharamshi sells 8,983,700 shares in the offer for sale, so money is coming to them.
Proceeds of ₹243.46 crore are scheduled for on or about Wednesday, October 21, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares are estimated at ₹2,421.85 crore; a family link exists with Kusum Harish Dharamshi, another holder.
Their role is unknown, so confirm their position before the call.
